title: Not a single seed has sprouted
text: Not a single seed has sprouted. My daughter,  who has a definite green thumb,  planted these seeds,  kept them watered and in the sunlight, but not a single one sprouted! She planted 15 little pots with potting soil and a variety of these seeds-endive, spinach, butter lettuce, etc. It's ridiculous that none of them sprouted at all.  Very disappointing, I don't recommend these.
